description: 4 insurance companies made $70 billion in profit last year — while 1 in 3 Americans can't afford their prescriptions. A third of your paycheck goes to health insurance. That's more than your rent, your car, your food. I'm Dr. Witta — cancer doctor, running for Congress in Colorado District 6 as an Independent. I've seen what this system does to real people. I'm running to fix it.
title: $70 Billion in Profit. While You Can't Afford Healthcare. | Dr. Witta | News
